name: mcp-builder
summary: Anthropic 的 mcp-builder 指南介绍如何构建 MCP 服务器，让语言模型通过工具访问外部 API。指南涵盖 Python 和 Node/TypeScript 开发方式，以及如何设计彼此独立、只需执行只读操作的评估问题。

Anthropic’s mcp-builder guide covers building MCP servers that give language models access to external APIs through tools. It describes Python and Node/TypeScript approaches and how to design independent, read-only evaluation questions.
